study: Event-time policy updates controlling an original M1 Go2 and W44 speed actor
eligibility: Observed confirmed all-stance; bounded hold unavailable immediately following another hold. Standing phases are outside the policy clock.
observation: W59 measured and published controller_state plus previous mode one-hot, elapsed duration and current admissibility

critic: same full causal input; common 64x64 tanh, zero output initialization
reward: original W38 physical-time progress/indentation/slip/time/cap change/lap/physical-terminal settlement

development: Causal 2x2 physical contrast before admission: transfer vs hold, positive/negative swing/timing. No reward-sign gate. First-state controls start from same A home.
distinct_ids: study + method + seed + version + case + attempt + event number. No cross-head replay.
terminals: physical failure or success zero bootstrap; batch/horizon/technical cut separates GAE. Three full empty episodes=end head. Solver/identity failure recorded separately.
gpu_device: frozen legacy W44 speed actors on CUDA; common hybrid learning and inference on CPU
